Eaura Pvt Ltd Employee Handbook  
Document Version: 1.0 
Classification: Internal Use (Fictional Sample Dataset) 
Welcome 
Welcome to Eaura Pvt Ltd. This employee handbook is a fictional document created for 
internal knowledge retrieval and testing purposes. It outlines sample workplace policies, 
expectations, and procedures. 
Code of Conduct 
Employees are expected to maintain professionalism, respect colleagues, avoid harassment,

protect confidential information, and comply with ethical business standards. 
Working Hours 
Standard working hours are 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday through Friday, with flexible 
arrangements subject to manager approval. 
Attendance and Leave 
Employees may request casual leave, sick leave, earned leave, and unpaid leave through the 
HR portal. Unplanned absences should be reported promptly. 
Remote Work Policy 
Hybrid and remote work may be permitted depending on business needs, performance

expectations, and manager approval. 
Compensation and Benefits 
Compensation includes salary, annual review eligibility, performance incentives, health 
insurance, and optional wellness benefits. 
IT Security 
Employees must use strong passwords, avoid sharing credentials, secure company devices, 
and report suspicious activity immediately.

Data Privacy 
Customer and internal data must be handled in accordance with privacy requirements and 
internal access control practices. 
Performance Management 
Employees participate in periodic performance reviews based on goals, collaboration, 
quality, and organizational contribution. 
Disciplinary Policy 
Policy violations may result in coaching, written warnings, suspension, or termination 
depending on severity. 
Grievance Process

depending on severity. 
Grievance Process 
Employees may raise workplace concerns through managers, HR representatives, or 
designated ethics reporting channels. 
Travel and Expense 
Business travel requires approval. Reimbursable expenses must be documented and 
submitted within prescribed timelines. 
Asset Usage 
Company laptops, software licenses, and access credentials are for authorized business use 
only. 
Separation

Separation 
Resignation, termination, and exit procedures include notice periods, knowledge transfer, 
and return of company assets. 
Company-Specific Practices 
Eaura Pvt Ltd emphasizes digital services, client engagement workflows, service delivery 
standards, operational responsiveness, and support quality metrics.

Sankalpa Employee Handbook - Fictional RAG demonstration document
Page 1
 Sankalpa Employee Handbook
 Version 1.0 | Internal Use | Fictional Sample Dataset
Purpose
A fictional policy reference created solely for RAG demonstration and testing.
Applies to
All Sankalpa employees unless a written employment agreement states otherwise.
Policy contact
People Operations at peopleops@sankalpa.example
1. Working Hours

1. Working Hours
Sankalpa standard working hours are 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM, Monday through Friday. Employees may
request flexible arrangements from their manager.
2. Leave and Attendance
Sankalpa employees receive 12 days of annual leave and 6 days of sick leave each calendar year.
Unplanned absences must be reported to the manager before the workday begins.
3. Remote Work
Sankalpa permits hybrid work for eligible roles with manager approval. Remote employees must protect

company information and remain available during agreed working hours.
4. Benefits
Sankalpa provides health insurance and an annual wellness allowance to eligible employees. People
Operations can explain eligibility and enrollment.

Sankalpa Employee Handbook - Fictional RAG demonstration document
Page 2
 Sankalpa Employee Handbook
 Operational Policies
5. Travel and Reimbursement
Business travel requires written manager approval before booking. Sankalpa reimburses reasonable
business expenses when employees submit receipts through the expense portal within 30 days.
6. Information Security
Sankalpa employees must use strong passwords, protect company devices, and report suspected
phishing or data loss to IT immediately.

phishing or data loss to IT immediately.
7. Performance and Conduct
Sankalpa conducts performance reviews twice each year. Employees are expected to treat colleagues
respectfully and follow the company code of conduct.
8. Separation
Employees who resign from Sankalpa are expected to provide 30 days of written notice, complete
knowledge transfer, and return company property before their final day.
How to query this handbook

How to query this handbook
Use a document reference plus a policy topic. Example: According to the Sankalpa employee
handbook, what are the standard working hours?
